notes: *The little hills*: supplied *The* is the noun's (rule 15) and *little* is the ASV's specifier on a class noun it writes bare for גִּבְעָה elsewhere, so it joins the unit and the head stays on *hills* (rule 31); not `added`.

בְנֵי צֹאן → *lambs* checked as a large-source-unit candidate: one English word writes both lexemes, neither morpheme owns a part, so the fusion is genuinely indivisible and heads on the construct standing first (rules 30, 23); צֹאן is the competing head.
